milestone: OS2HOST32 VIO R2 full cell state

baseline.user_runtime_report: Phase-1 behavior reported as working well enough to proceed

common_state.cell_format: unsigned char character + unsigned char OS/2 attribute

semantic_results.VioWrtCharStr: backend render then common character update; attribute preserved; cursor unchanged
semantic_results.VioWrtCharStrAtt: backend render then common character+OS/2 attribute update; cursor unchanged
semantic_results.VioScrollUp: backend scroll then matching common cell move/fill
semantic_results.VioWrtTTY: native stream write retained; opportunistic console resnapshot afterwards
semantic_results.VioGetCurPos_SetCurPos: common state retained with backend synchronization
semantic_results.VioGetCurType_SetCurType: common state retained with Win32 cursor approximation

known_boundaries: Win32 cursor size is percentage-based; OS/2 scan-line shape remains approximate.
OS/2 attribute bit 7 is retained in common state but dropped by Win32 rendering rather than being misrepresented as background intensity.
DosWrite(stdout) is not routed through VIO; external host writes can temporarily desynchronize the common cell image.
Win32 Console remains the only backend.
